conversationVariables.description: This variable may also be referred to as VerifiedCustomerId
conversationVariables.label: Verified Customer ID

conversationVariables.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (such as Account or Opportunity) associated with the record the user wants to interact with. Do not use this if the user is already talking about another object in the conversation.
conversationVariables.label: Current Object API Name

conversationVariables.description: The ID of the record on the user's screen. It may not relate to the user's input. Only use this if the user input mentions 'this', 'current', 'the record', etc. If in doubt, don't use it.
conversationVariables.label: Current Record Id

conversationVariables.description: Stores the conversation history to provide context for answering questions. If the user says 'Continue from the preceding conversation' and this variable has content, inform: 'I can answer questions and help you with tasks related to this page.'
conversationVariables.label: Preceding Conversation

AiAgentDefinitionVersion.welcomeMessage: Hi! I'm Agentforce, an AI assistant. I can do things like search your Salesforce data or the internet, edit your Salesforce records, and draft or revise emails and fields. Ask me "What else can you do?" to see how I can help simplify your work day.
